fastmail-dav-api.$comment: Any request to Fastmail's CardDAV or CalDAV hosts. Separate from fastmail-api because these endpoints take an app password over Basic auth rather than the JMAP OAuth token.

fastmail-dav-discover.$comment: Discover the authenticated principal and the collections belonging to it (a current-user-principal PROPFIND, RFC 5397). Required before any DAV client can locate an address book or calendar.

fastmail-dav-read-all.$comment: Read any DAV resource: PROPFIND and REPORT to enumerate and sync collections, GET to fetch individual vCards or iCalendar objects.

fastmail-dav-write-all.$comment: Create, update or delete any DAV resource or collection.

fastmail-dav-read-contacts.$comment: Read address books and vCards over CardDAV (RFC 6352).

fastmail-dav-write-contacts.$comment: Create, update or delete address books and vCards over CardDAV.

fastmail-dav-read-calendars.$comment: Read calendars and iCalendar objects over CalDAV (RFC 4791).

fastmail-dav-write-calendars.$comment: Create, update or delete calendars and events over CalDAV, including scheduling messages sent to participants.
